changes.to: Maker homepage describes Maker H01 as a physical-AGI native body: adult-height version of about 1.6 m, 'twenty-plus' whole-body DoF, high-DoF dual arms on a mobile chassis, GigaBrain end-to-end VLA and GigaWorld simulation. No numeric spec table is published, so dimensions, mass, payload, battery and price stay empty. Third-party catalogue figures (28 DoF, 64 kg, 5 kg payload, 2.2 m/s, 160-162 cm) were not used.
GigaAI's wheeled industrial and service humanoid (about 1.6 m, twenty-plus DoF, dual 7-DoF arms) built as the body for its GigaBrain VLA model.
